title: Document commit_bead_state toggle in CLAUDE.md
description: Update CLAUDE.md in three places: (1) under ## Configuration (CLAUDE.md:113), insert a new paragraph after the CommonConfig fields paragraph documenting commit_bead_state — default True for existing repos, False for new takt init projects, what it suppresses, and when to flip it; (2) immediately after that paragraph, add a new H3 '### Cleaning bead-state history in an existing repo' with the 4-step manual opt-in recipe (set flag false, add .gitignore entry, git rm -r --cached .takt/beads/, optional destructive history purge note); (3) in ## Conventions (CLAUDE.md:204), append one sentence to the bead-state-exclusion bullet: when the flag is off, _git_commit_bead/_git_commit_bead_deletion are no-ops; worktree-exclude and merge=ours still apply for repos that keep the flag on.
acceptance_criteria: ## Configuration section contains the commit_bead_state documentation paragraph
## Configuration section contains '### Cleaning bead-state history in an existing repo' with all 4 recipe steps
## Conventions bead-state-exclusion bullet ends with the new sentence about the flag
